name: auto-scoring
description: Auto-Scoring: human-in-the-loop AI grading assistant for handwritten answer PDFs (Flutter desktop + Python sidecar).

scripts.lint:app: cd app && dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed lib test && flutter analyze
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:app && pnpm run lint:backend
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:app && pnpm run typecheck:backend
scripts.test: pnpm run test:app && pnpm run test:backend
scripts.package:sidecar: cd backend && uv run pyinstaller packaging/auto-scoring-sidecar.spec --noconfirm --clean --distpath dist --workpath build
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && uv run python -c "import auto_scoring; print(auto_scoring.__version__)"
scripts.build: pnpm run build:app && pnpm run build:backend
scripts.check:pre-push: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.check: pnpm skills:check && pnpm format:check && pnpm openapi:selftest && pnpm openapi:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
